protocol.scope: same-day frozen buy/sell client queue with day-end residual replanning; not undeployed close-sell/next-open scheduler
protocol.horizon: three exchange sessions including first day; adjacent-natural-day reference requirement remains
protocol.cash: whole buy must be affordable before submission; no projected proceeds; source queue cash_readiness function
protocol.finality: all residual active orders assumed broker-confirmed cancelled at each day close before retries
protocol.references: QMT official daily close for planning; original 50bp price envelope fixed
protocol.replanning: source replan_residual function; only original residuals; cash buffer 0% (production monthly target); original share ceiling
protocol.fill_model: adverse open slippage or strict-through limit; per-bar volume cap; never proof of exchange queue fill
protocol.cutoff: bar end strictly before 14:55; coarse final bars excluded conservatively
protocol.latency: sell proceeds observable and spendable next bar, or two bars in stress; NOT a 30-second latency estimate
protocol.fees: actual modeled 1bp minimum CNY5 per symbol/day; submission reserve 10bp minimum CNY5
protocol.sample: frozen reconstructed historical weights; common starts from previous daily baseline model; not actual account or out-of-sample
protocol.exclusions: initial investment, incomplete minute windows, corporate ex/payment events within three-day windows
protocol.denominator: same original requested quantity times original reference price across arms; never reduced after scaling
protocol.uncertainty: no tick trades, order-book queues, broker report timestamps or actual finality latency

checks: no repeated fills beyond original requested quantity
same initial denominator and first-day fills across arms
